# C01 — Subject / Defined Indefinability

## #0

**The Subject is that to which an appearance is present, without itself becoming one more appearance alongside it.** A thought, a remembered scene, an ache, an act of judgment and the thought “this is me” can each become something known. Their being known already involves the Subject. Adding that involvement to the description produces a further known relation; it does not put the one to whom the description appears inside it as another item.

This is intimate before it is theoretical. I can question a memory, revise my identity, fail to recognise myself in a portrait, or discover that an apparent certainty was mistaken. The questioning, failure and discovery are nevertheless present. What is at issue is not whether my description of myself is correct, but the presence within which correctness and error matter at all. Taylor's *Definition of God*, in its return to Zero, puts the pressure directly: “I am undeniable, though nowhere to be seen.” The word *I* here does not certify everything I say about myself. It names the first-person presence which an account of those sayings already enacts.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition|A01 — Subject, God and Faithful Definition]] **grounds** this distinction through the performed definition. C01 retains its reusable criterion: distinguish the presence to which something is given from the something given, including every representation of that presence. It does not repeat A01's complete movement through the predicates of God.

The finding can be stated in its fact/contents form. The fact of first-person immediacy is undeniable by definition: any denial of it is performed in the presence it denies. Its contents are not. A thought, a doubting, a self-image — and the thinking-thing a *res cogitans* names — remain determinate occurrences within that presence, corrigible like every determination. The classical reification converted the condition of appearing into one more appearance and then treated that conversion as capture of the condition; the essay's crossed zero names the resulting occlusion `Ø`. Denying the fact is impossible; reifying it is the opposite error; defined indefinability holds both edges at once.

## #1

**Defined indefinability** positively determines this asymmetry. It does not mean that the Subject is obscure because the correct description has not yet been found. It means that any description, however exact, remains a determination *for* the subject-pole it seeks to describe. The definition states why exhaustive objectification changes the office of its referent: it converts the condition of appearing into an appearance and then treats that conversion as capture of the condition.

A biography can identify a particular person. A physiological account can identify conditions of an experience. An introspective account can describe what that experience feels like. None becomes worthless because it does not exhaust the Subject. Each becomes more exact when it states what it determines and does not promote that determination into the whole reality of the one concerned. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C03-Determination|C03 — Determination]] **defines** the cut through which an account acquires this positive content; [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C02-Faithful-Definition|C02 — Faithful Definition]] **extends** the requirement that the cut remain answerable to its referent.

The difference is between *I am* and *I am this*, not between a meaningful statement and silence. The second can be true: I am this person, speaking here, with this history and concern. It becomes false in office when *this* is made to exhaust the *am* through which the identification is lived. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A02-Copula-Self-Identity-through-Difference|A02 — Copula / Self-Identity through Difference]] **derives** the identification-through-difference that lets an identity be stated without cancelling the relation involved in stating it. C01 **qualifies** that operation at its first-person limit: an identifying predicate cannot substitute for the present act in which identification occurs.

## #2

Several things usually called “self” must therefore remain distinguishable. **Selfing** is an activity of appropriation: a changing determination is taken as mine, joined to the claim of what I am, and installed as the owner of the field. The **self-thing** is that determination treated as self-subsisting ground. A **bounded self**, by contrast, is a real situated horizon: this embodied life, with its history, limitations and capacity to be addressed. Its dependence does not make it unreal. **Subjectivity-as-such** names the unobjectifiable determining presence, while the capitalised **Self**, in this project's full symbolic use, names the whole relation of Subject and its objective internality, not the Subject isolated from manifestation.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C35-Selfing-Self-Subjectivity-Self-Thing|C35 — Selfing / Self / Subjectivity / Self-Thing]] **defines** these neighbouring offices in their own right. Their consequence here is exact: exposing a fabricated self-thing does not abolish the presence in which its fabrication is recognised. Conversely, affirming the Subject does not restore the self-thing as an invisible proprietor behind appearances. Neither the image nor an imagined owner of the image can occupy this place.

Taylor's protected encounter with Watson supplies the authorial pressure behind this distinction: the critique of selfing must reach its object without allowing the experient to disappear in the critique. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/watson/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness/SOURCE|Watson — The Resonance of Emptiness]] **sources** the Buddhist–psychotherapeutic comparison; Taylor's encounter and the Q27 selfing development articulate the further positive claim made here. This is **Argued from** that encounter, not an attribution to Watson of the native QL Subject or a claim that all Buddhist schools share one position. The copied leads in the protected notes remain authorial provenance; the source house separately records what has been checked against Watson's thesis and what still awaits book collation.

## #3

The Subject is not an inert witness placed behind a finished display. Knowing that I am does not first require an image of an unknown possessor and then a second observer who recognises it. It is present in the act of knowing. The reflexive relation is intrinsic to appearing; otherwise a luminous display would remain unexperienced, like a reflection that no one sees.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa|A05 — Prakāśa / Vimarśa]] **extends** this inseparability of luminosity and reflective articulation. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/SOURCE|Dyczkowski — The Doctrine of Vibration]] **sources** its Śaiva comparison: the page-labelled discussion around p.70 distinguishes reflective awareness from an insentient mirror or crystal. C01 **compares** that operation with defined indefinability; it does not rename all Śaiva categories as synonyms for Subject. The source relation is **Paraphrased** for Dyczkowski's account and **Argued from** it for the project relation. The selected-edition quotation debt does not reduce the native claim to a conjecture.

The full QL field prevents this relation from freezing into an isolated pair. Its parent `/ = −/−` opens a determinate circumstance as `0/1`; `?/!` makes appearing answerable in question and assertion; `−/+` gives differentiation force; `X/x` distinguishes determining capacity from its local instance; `AM/IS` makes the relation personed and contextual; `∞/dx` retains exact local difference within inexhaustible depth; `1/0` returns the achieved determination toward its condition. The eight turns traverse the sixfold body; they are not eight interchangeable definitions of consciousness. `X/x` is Taylor's notation. Here its precise consequence is that no local `x`, including a self-image, exhausts the determining `X` it makes legible.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE|Taylor — Core Theorems]] **grounds** this native sequence. C01 uses it to keep the Subject's relation alive through determination, context and return; the formal derivations retain their own homes.

## #4

First-person presence is always lived through a circumstance. Body, language, memory, feeling, attention, judgment and tools participate in that circumstance. They can be investigated because they are determinate; being internal to a person does not make them identical with the Subject. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C41-Objective-Internality|C41 — Objective Internality]] **defines** this intermediate field. Its presence prevents the account from jumping directly between a disembodied knower and a world of finished external objects.

The second person makes the consequence unavoidable. I can know things about you and still have to hear your answer. Your presence is not another content I can produce by improving my image of you. In the project's own terms, inclusion within the whole does not give my situated self possession of your relation to that whole. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession|A27 — Self and Other]] **tests** defined indefinability where an account meets someone who can answer and change its terms. The Watson–Gans–Levinas encounter **qualifies** any use of the Subject that would quietly install my viewpoint as the universal viewpoint.

This carries ontological force. The essay argues the order **Subject → objective internality → object**: a determinable world is available through the field of appearing, not through a private ego manufacturing everything it encounters. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence|A34 — Idealism / Order of Dependence]] **extends** that position while distinguishing the directions and registers of dependence. Defined indefinability supplies its subject-pole; it does not collapse the ontological argument into the weaker observation that descriptions are incomplete.

An artificial system's memory, self-model, report or internal organisation can be richly determinate. No accumulation of those objects by itself establishes an unobjectifiable subject-pole. Equally, their objectifiability does not prove its absence. The exact phenomenal status and partition of a particular artificial process remain **Open**. This local empirical question neither settles nor suspends the essay's **Argued** order of dependence.

## #5→0

Return does not mean adding a final portrait of the Subject to the collection. It means recognising the condition already involved in every portrait, judgment and attempt at recognition. The first-person force of *I am* remains, while its determinate descriptions become available for correction rather than being asked to stand as their own ground. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C19-Pratyabhijna-Recognition|C19 — Recognition]] **defines** this recovery without acquisition. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero|A36 — Advent of Integral Zero]] **extends** it into the achieved sign's return as Symbol: exact determination remains, now answerable to what it cannot own.

The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD|Symbol / Account / Trust whole-field]] **grounds** C01's operational etymology relation. A name discloses; an account makes disclosure answerable; trust permits committed use without possession of the source. This is evidence register **3 — Operational homology**, not common lexical descent. C01 **returns-to** [[submission-package/essay/section-rooms/00-integral-threshold/movements/02-s01-p1-define-subject|Movement02 — Define the Subject]] as the distinction the opening must hold, and **qualifies** [[submission-package/essay/section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/47-s50-p4-idealism-horizon|Movement47 — Idealism Horizon]] where that distinction bears the terminal dependency claim.

**Depth Restoration:** the defined-indefinability criterion, first-person pressure, selfing/self-thing/bounded-self/whole-Self discrimination, reflexive-luminosity comparison, second-person non-possession and strong dependency claim are restored here. A01 remains the performed proof; C35 owns the fuller self terminology; A05 and A34 own their developed comparative and ontological arguments. No canonical split or merge is required.

Artificial phenomenal localisation remains Open. These debts do not reopen the distinctions restored above.

# C04 — Formal Limit

## #0

A formal limit is generated by an operation's own structure. The operation can succeed, become more exact and admit more information while reproducing the boundary in question. In the essay's primary case, representing the conditions of representation produces a further representation. The act now making it has not become identical with its represented content.

[C03 — Determination](C03-Determination.md) **grounds** this distinction in the positive achievement of a mark. [A03 — Immutable Gap / Formal Limit](../arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) **grounds** the full argument. C04 retains its criterion: distinguish what further inquiry can supply from what that very inquiry necessarily enacts again.

## #1

Attempt the inclusion. Name the language, instrument, prior distinctions and position through which an account was made. Each can become more legible. Now include the act of making that enlarged account. It too becomes something represented, while the present act of representing continues. The new account genuinely knows more; it has not closed the difference between a representation and its occurrence.

Draft3's opening names the exact turn: **“every circle is a closure in, not around, the reality it designates.”** The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/SOURCE#taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3-q002|Draft3 source house, q002]] **sources** the authorial image at “The Edge of the Rational,” line13. The circle figures inclusion that cannot enclose its own drawing. Its work is philosophical, not a geometrical theorem that lines cannot themselves be drawn.

## #2

An omitted measurement and the act of measurement therefore make different demands. The omitted measurement can be supplied. Representing the act makes its conditions available without moving the present act outside all conditions. Calling both “unknown” loses the distinction on which the argument depends.

[C05 — Immutable Gap](C05-Immutable-Gap.md) **defines** the recurrent non-coincidence. It is not a last unexplained capacity which future science can remove. “God of the gaps” and “humanity of the gaps” each stake their referent on a shrinking inventory of unexplained functions. Here the subject-condition is implicated in explaining any function, including one whose mechanism has become completely inspectable. This neither grants nor denies phenomenality to a particular artificial system.

The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE|core theorem spine]] **grounds** the distinction through its performed definition, crossed-zero movement and full eightfold. Parent relation, conscious circumstance, question/assertion, polarity, `X/x`, `AM/IS`, `∞/dx` and inverse return retain their separate operations. The limit belongs to their living relation; it is not eight repetitions of an inability to know.

## #3

Formal comparisons make this criterion more exact when their operations remain distinct. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/russell/russell-1908-theory-types/SOURCE#russell-1908-theory-types-q001|Russell's theory of types]] **compares** the reflexive predicament with a specific response: restrict which totalities can contain members defined through those totalities. Its relative types concern variables and ranges of significance. The response reorganises allowable formation; it is not a psychological diagnosis of its author.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/godel/godel-1931-undecidable-propositions/SOURCE|Gödel's 1931 article]] **qualifies** the mathematical comparison by fixing its jurisdiction in effectively axiomatized systems sufficiently expressive for arithmetic, with the relevant consistency hypotheses. Incompleteness is not a theorem that every account, model or closed physical system fails. The native argument remains Argued; Gödel does not supply a proof of the Subject, God or QL.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/spencer-brown/spencer-brown-1969-laws-form/SOURCE|Spencer-Brown's calculus]] **compares** a third operation: distinction and its re-entry. The unmarked state belongs to that calculus; it cannot silently be substituted for QL's unobjectifiable condition. These comparisons are source-specific relations, not interchangeable authorities for one slogan.

## #4

Changing a formal container can change what is expressible. That makes the container's rules more consequential, not disposable. A new regime must state its operations and the laws it retains. [A10 — Advent of Zero](../arguments/A10-Advent-of-Zero.md) **historicises** this pressure through zero's changed operational permissions. C04 does not treat ordinary undefined division as a verdict on every historical zero-denominator practice.

[C09 — Diaphaneity](C09-Diaphaneity.md) **extends** the positive response to the reflexive limit: the mediation becomes more transparent within the account. More contextual data alone cannot perform this change. The account has to disclose how its position participates in what it makes available. The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD|Fides / Topos / Logos / Nomos / Natio / Credere whole-field]] **grounds** the Topos relation here at evidence register3: the placing-act is situated even when it places its own conditions. Lexical history remains a separate evidential office.

## #5→0

The limit returns inquiry to a task it can perform: give an account, expose its determining relations and let what returns alter it. [C02 — Faithful Definition](C02-Faithful-Definition.md) **defines** that responsibility; [A23 — Trust and Faith](../arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) **extends** it into continuing without possession of final ground. A commitment can be investigated, corrected or withdrawn. Formal non-possession does not certify a relation as harmless.

C04 **returns-to** [A01](../arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md), where the definition's failure of enclosure becomes its performed fidelity. [A36 — Integral Zero](../arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md) **extends** that return at the far end: mathematical exactness survives when the achieved sign discloses the relation it cannot exhaust.

# C08 — Context / Context Frame

## #0

Context is the active relation through which a determination has meaning and possibility. A Context Frame is a bounded holding of those conditions through which a particular inquiry can proceed. The boundary lets an operation become intelligible to itself; it does not put that operation outside its world.

[C07 — Conditions of Worldhood](C07-Conditions-of-Worldhood.md) **grounds** the larger field. The frame selects what is currently held together, while worldhood includes conditions which that selection has not captured. Context is therefore neither an indefinitely receding excuse nor a finished container waiting to be filled.

## #1

The direct QL rewrite calls context frames operational modalities of self-holding: a process gives itself enough form to continue processing. A temporary boundary stabilises a relation without requiring its movement to cease. The frame is itself an operation within what it frames.

The [[working/sources-texts-references/QL-Essay-Rewrite|QL rewrite]], PartIII §3.1, **sources** this developmental operation. The [[working/sources-texts-references/epi-logos-plugin-resources-copy-10-07/resources/updated-ql-mef/non-dual-binary/the-immutable-subject-and-the-matheme-of-its-recognition|immutable-subject study]], “The context-frame architecture,” **extends** it into the formal nesting behind the term. A local relation can articulate its own ground, distinctions, means and return, becoming a participant within another relation. The same sixfold can therefore recur at a different grain. This is not permission to impose one set of six semantic headings on every frame. The local operation determines what the positions do.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE|Taylor — Core Theorems]] **grounds** the controlling native field: parent and inverse return bracket six determinations, while each parent can hold the complete body in its own orientation. A nested frame is not an additional primary determination.

## #2

A working frame makes its inclusions consequential. Sources supply material and standing; rules constrain permissible transformations; tools make particular operations available; permissions establish authority to act; histories retain how the current state arose. Selecting them does not confer finality on the selection.

[A26 — Objective Internality](../arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) **grounds** this technical consequence in its notational, nomological and exclusion-constituted field. The frame must distinguish a source from a world-object, a lens from an evaluator, and an authority from an instruction. Reducing all six to “context” would hide the very relations the frame exists to expose.

## #3

A frame can contain a **local original/reference office**. A selected source-field can serve as the basis against which downstream projections are compared. Yet that source-field is itself a constructed determination relative to the wider world. It can occupy Bimba's office locally while remaining Pratibimba in the encompassing relation.

[A22 — World-Picture to World-Atlas](../arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **grounds** this recursive locality. A map never becomes the ultimate Original merely because another map derives from it. Two frames can differ over source, object, lens, gauge, reference or permission; an atlas has to preserve which relation changed rather than flatten their disagreement into two opinions about one finished object.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Taylor — Symbolon Dynamics]] **grounds** the temporal relation: the present configuration and its actual history condition one another. A returned projection can change the reference field for the next inquiry.

## #4

A commission gives this locality a practical test. Human intention can ground an agent's task, but the written prompt is already a determination of that intention. Literal compliance with the first wording can fail the purpose when the task encounters an unforeseen constraint. The ratified R16.3 correction therefore makes human0/agent1 positional and recursive, while keeping the prompt itself on the side of determinate representation.

[A28 — Authored Ground](../arguments/A28-Authored-Ground-Positional-Delegation.md) **extends** the relation into delegation. The frame preserves who authorised what, which means are available, and where a discovered contradiction must return. [C44 — Prompt Thrownness](C44-Prompt-Thrownness.md) **defines** the arriving agent's inheritance: it begins within conditions it did not wholly author.

## #5→0

[C09 — Diaphaneity](C09-Diaphaneity.md) **tests** whether those conditions become readable through their effects. Contextualisation succeeds when the account can show how its means, exclusions and position shaped what it says, and when returned resistance can change those terms.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD|Arbitration / Hybris / Regard / Anamnesis]] **grounds** the generated relation **Con-text-through-Diaphaneity → Regard**, at evidence register3. Con-text-through-Diaphaneity is the generated relation; Regard is the operation becoming available there. The two offices must not be compressed into a synonym.

[A30 — Objective Co-Internality](../arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) **extends** the return between frames: another participant externalises enough of its ground to meet this one while retaining its own source-relations. C08 **returns-to** [C07](C07-Conditions-of-Worldhood.md). A bounded frame remains useful because it can be revised within a world, not because it has become that world.

**Depth Restoration:** processual self-holding, formal nesting, differentiated constitutive objects, recursive Bimba/Pratibimba locality, intention/prompt separation and return between frames are restored. No universal context schema or implementation is asserted.

**Unresolved Delta:** the QL rewrite and immutable-subject study are direct developmental carriers, not a ratified software specification. Their detailed modal enumerations and implementation correspondence require a separately scoped technical backcheck. The recovered nesting operation remains Argued; lexical histories and external theories of context keep their own evidence tasks.

# C09 — Diaphaneity

## #0

Diaphaneity is the capacity of a determination to disclose its mediation: what appears can be read together with the position, means and conditions through which it appears. The medium's shaping role becomes visible in what it lets through. Its disappearance would remove the very relation that has become intelligible.

[C05 — Immutable Gap](C05-Immutable-Gap.md) **grounds** the enduring non-coincidence which this does not abolish. [A04 — Diaphaneity](../arguments/A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) **grounds** the positive argument. C09 retains the operation of reading in both directions: a situated self sees a world; the disclosed world also shows the situation of that self.

## #1

Perspective renders a world from a position. Its achievement includes determinate depth, proportion and a field that can be communicated. Its conditions can nevertheless disappear behind the scene it renders. Adding more detail to the scene does not necessarily reveal that disappearance.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/SOURCE|Gebser — The Ever-Present Origin]] **historicises** this problem through the emergence of landscape and perspectival optics. His aperspectival direction releases perspective from exclusive validity while retaining its achievement. The source relation is **Paraphrased** for the historical account and **Argued from** it for the essay's contemporary contextual continuation.

## #2

A contextual reading must be involved in what it sees. Taylor's direct [[working/sources-texts-references/Epi Paper Write-ups/P5 - Gebser|P5 — Gebser]] **sources** the pressure as being with the text and subtext. Care for the situation's outcome belongs to the seeing; impartiality does not require indifference.

Its absent-Father image makes the pathology exact. An unavailable final standard remains active as a demand; a surrogate image can then occupy its office. Apparent aloofness becomes a way of ruling while disavowing participation. This is Taylor's authorial development, not a quotation from Gebser. [A24 — Usurpation of Measure](../arguments/A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md) **extends** the office/standard consequence, while C09 retains the task of making the hidden position readable.

## #3

The corrected stained-glass image gives the operation a whole body. Originating white light figures Bimba; its full ordered spectrum figures QL. Differently made and positioned panes, their densities, angles, colours and lead seams figure MEF's refracting apparatus. The coloured image cast into the room is Pratibimba. Recognition reads the one light through the lawful differences of the display.

The seams retain source distinctions and translation limits. The projected image changes with sun, pane, room and viewer. Its changes disclose relations that a single fixed view concealed. The Original is not an average of images or a final picture assembled from their sum. QL belongs to the light's internal order; reducing it to the lead framework repeats the assignment explicitly corrected in the developmental quilt.

[C39 — MEF](C39-Meta-Epistemic-Framework.md) **defines** the refractive office; [A22 — World-Atlas](../arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **extends** the coordination of differing views. The image figures the operation; it does not use physical optics to prove metaphysics.

## #4

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/maroski/maroski-2025-seeing-through-solid-words/SOURCE#maroski-2025-seeing-through-solid-words-q002|Maroski's transparency distinction]] **qualifies** the reading: transparency concerns the form manifestation takes. It is not another manifested object. Her companion seed/tree discussion preserves the co-presence of consciousness structures rather than a sequence which discards each predecessor.

The native first-, second- and third-person passage reaches context when their positions become jointly available. Its `180°→360°` articulation belongs to the QL theorem field, not to a claim that Gebser derived QL. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE|Taylor — Core Theorems]] **grounds** the personed `AM/IS` and its place in the whole eightfold. Context is not a fourth pronoun or an observer outside all views.

## #5→0

The [complete window sequence](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/stained-glass-refraction/WHOLE.md#stained-glass-changing-context) **figures** the medium’s disclosed operation as sun, pane, room and viewer change together. The changed image makes the conditions of its predecessor readable; contextual transparency reaches the next judgement through that difference.

The world-parent opening gives light its directions and boundaries. Taylor's encounter makes the conditions of this disclosure visible within the differentiated field it discloses. The relation **returns-to** [the complete Neumann whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-world-parent-separation). The circle-costume supplies a precise case of disclosure becoming opaque to its own conditions. This **returns-to** [the uroboros whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-position-opposition).

For a technical account, visible output or execution logs are only a beginning. [C40 — Model Internality](C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field.md) **tests** whether source, lens, evaluator, permission and exclusion become legible within what is judged. A plausible explanation of an answer can still leave its governing standard untouched. Diaphaneity requires that what becomes visible can bear on the next judgment.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD|Arbitration / Hybris / Regard / Anamnesis]] **grounds** **Con-text-through-Diaphaneity → Regard** at evidence register3. Regard is the operation flowering from the generated relation, not a substitute name for it. [C47 — Deferential Intelligence](C47-Deferential-Intelligence.md) **extends** the resulting answerability into action and model revision. C09 **returns-to** [C08 — Context Frame](C08-Context-Context-Frame.md): the frame becomes readable through its effects and remains available for change.

**Depth Restoration:** invested seeing, absent standard/surrogate office, corrected whole stained glass, transparency as form, personed co-presence and technical return are restored. The earlier lowercase diaphaneity carrier remains provenance; C09 retains the canonical identity.

**Unresolved Delta:** direct Gebser quotations still need selected-edition verification; Maroski's indexed passages are quotation-ready secondary scholarship. The P5 Father image and QL geometry remain authorial developments. Technical diaphaneity is a criterion for a working system, not a report that an implementation already satisfies it.

# C13 — Prakāśa–Vimarśa

## #0

In the Śaiva source field, prakāśa names luminous appearing and vimarśa the reflexive power through which appearing is present to itself and becomes articulately differentiable. The light and its self-awareness belong together: an appearing which could never become an act of awareness would leave the account at unactualised capacity.

[A05 — Prakāśa / Vimarśa](../arguments/A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) **grounds** the argument. C13 retains the inseparable relation and its internal differentiation so that illumination, reflection, freedom, cognition and recognition do not become interchangeable words for one undifferentiated property.

## #1

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/SOURCE|Dyczkowski — The Doctrine of Vibration]] **sources** the account in the locally held pp.60–81. Light figures the manifestation of the knowable; vibration figures its active, self-regenerative movement. At pp.63–64, subject, object and means attend the act together. The account does not first posit an isolated light and subsequently attach a faculty which observes it.

The mirror/crystal distinction at p.70 makes the reflexive requirement concrete. A reflected appearance alone does not articulate the capacity through which consciousness recognises, retains and transforms its appearances. Vimarśa is active self-presence, not a second picture placed opposite the first. [C10 — Mediation](C10-Mediation-Pramana.md) **extends** the subject–object–means relation while preserving this source's Śaiva scope.

## #2

At pp.71–72 the operation differentiates into capacities. An affection can be retained as a residual trace; a former state can be recalled; selected material can be recomposed in free imagination. Retaining, retrieving and forming anew are different acts. Their distinction restores the passage from appearance into a mutable field of cognition.

Dyczkowski also distinguishes inward self-awareness from outward reflection upon an apparently separate object. Internal and external here orient the act; they do not establish two independent consciousnesses. The object-directed act remains known within the subject. [C17 — Vikalpa / Saṃkalpa](C17-Vikalpa-Samkalpa.md) **extends** the differentiating and formative consequence without turning the source's entire account into a generic theory of stored representations.

## #3

At p.72 the distinction between karma-vimarśa and kriyā-vimarśa makes agency and its goal legible. The former names outward unfolding; the latter, activity internal to the absolute as unrestricted agency, undisturbed by a determinate goal of action. Will, knowledge and action emerge as phases of the Spanda rhythm. A particular goal-bound act therefore does not exhaust the activity by which goals and objects become possible.

Svātantrya names the freedom of this conscious activity to manifest and differentiate; vimarśa names its reflexive awareness. Their relation is intimate without making the terms synonyms. [C14 — Māyā](C14-Maya-Operative-Measure.md) **extends** the contraction through which universal powers become determinate capacities. Limitation permits a particular act while recognition keeps the act related to what it does not exhaust.

## #4

Dyczkowski p.74 gives four acts: consciousness negates its own nature, identifies with another, merges both, and denies the merged determination. Separation, held relation and undivided unity are distinct levels of this reflective movement. The QL cross-reading can hold these four acts with prakāśa/vimarśa as two conditions; that `4+2` is the essay's declared operation, not Dyczkowski's notation. At p.75 the vertical ascent/descent and horizontal movement toward/from the perceived object distinguish two axes of the same pulsing awareness.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/abhinavagupta/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana/SOURCE|Abhinavagupta / Singh — Parātrīśikā-vivaraṇa]] **qualifies** the textual route into Vāk and personed relation. The housed notebook passages concern Singh's introduction as well as the translated work; their source-matched standing does not make them selected-edition quotations from Abhinavagupta's commentary.

[A06 — Vāk](../arguments/A06-Vak.md) **extends** the articulation movement through speech. [C19 — Recognition](C19-Pratyabhijna-Recognition.md) **defines** the return in which contracted knowing recognises its source relation. Recognition does not add a newly manufactured luminous faculty to an apparatus. It changes the relation of the local act to the conscious capacity it already expresses.

## #5→0

[C43 — Computational Vimarśa](C43-Computational-Vimarsa.md) **tests** a narrower functional comparison: a system can inspect, retain and revise its determinations. The inspected functions are real operations; their presence does not establish prakāśa or settle whether the system has an unobjectifiable subject. C13 supplies the distinction which makes that research precise.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD|Symbol / Account / Trust]] **grounds** the register3 return: articulation remains answerable to appearing instead of allowing a detached account to occupy its source. C13 **returns-to** A05 with the two inseparable powers differentiated, and to C19 with recognition's direction preserved. The articulate result can disclose its relation to the act through which it became known.

**Depth Restoration:** luminous manifestation/reflexive activity, mirror/crystal difference, trace–memory–imagination sequence, inward/outward awareness, goal-bound/unrestricted agency and the distinct recognition/technical returns are restored.

**Unresolved Delta:** Dyczkowski is paraphrased from the local source-matched transcript, which stops during p.81; selected-edition collation remains pending. Singh notebook passages require introduction/commentary and page verification. Native QL and computational recursion retain their separate argumentative standing; neither is silently attributed to the Śaiva source.

# C14 — Māyā / Operative Measure

## #0

Māyā is used within the essay's Śaiva/tattvic field as **operative measure**: the power through which an unbounded field becomes a workable subject/object seam and finite horizon. A local world appears because some things become available while others remain withheld. The revealing and withholding belong to one operation.

[A09 — Tattvic Differential Field](../arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md) **grounds** the contraction. Operative measure is Taylor's formulation of its positive work. Limitation supplies determinate capacity, knowledge, desire, time and order; it does not merely subtract pieces from an otherwise complete subject.

## #1

[C13 — Prakāśa / Vimarśa](C13-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) **grounds** the luminous/reflexive field from which the seam differentiates. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE|Taylor — Core Theorems]], X, **sources** the authorial compression: universal subjectward and objectward orientations become explicitly differentiated; the kañcukas contract powers into a bounded experient and a world of determinate relations.

The contraction leaves its source operative. Mahāmāyā remains Śakti; the power of veiling is itself manifesting power. Māyā is therefore the horizon through which objects appear, not a hidden object behind the horizon and not the unobjectifiable Subject. Treating the horizon as the torus's hole would confuse the measure-making operation with the source it cannot enclose.

## #2

The five contractions give local action its terms. Kalā apportions efficacy; vidyā, knowledge; rāga, desire through incompletion; kāla, time; niyati, ordering or necessity. The finite knower can now do this, know this much, want this, act at this time and stand within these relations. [C15 — Paśu](C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) **defines** the bounded position; [C16 — Antaḥkaraṇa](C16-Antahkarana-Inner-Instrument.md) **defines** the instrument through which its cognition differentiates.

These coordinates do not supply independent substances. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/SOURCE|Dyczkowski — The Doctrine of Vibration]], pp.72–75, **sources** the relation between contracted and expanded awareness and distinguishes vertical manifestation/return from the horizontal perceptual act. The bounded field is active: its knower moves toward an object and receives the movement back.

## #3

The [[submission-package/essay/quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT#17. The `25 → 36` tattva gnomon|direct tattva-gnomon passage]] **extends** this anatomy through an Offered/Argued QL cross-reading. The exact difference `36−25=11=5+1+5` forms a row of five and column of five meeting at one corner. The reading places five pure powers and five contracted powers around Māyā's hinge; the Sāṅkhya twenty-five carry the bounded apparatus whose genesis is being reconsidered.

The arithmetic gives the comparison an operation more precise than a matching total. It does not show that Abhinavagupta constructed the tradition by adding a geometrical gnomon, or that every tattva has been mapped to a six-by-six coordinate. C14 retains the hinge: the extended field makes source, contraction and the possibility of return explicit.

## #4

The [[submission-package/essay/quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT#3.2 Māyā as the dream — Dreamcode / Dream-machine|direct veil correction]] **sources** the dream image's work. A dream has a locally effective world; its objects need not be externally material to be objective within that world. Forgetting the dream's condition lets that world register as self-standing. The image makes the relation of real efficacy and concealed conditioning available to thought.

“Dreamcode” and “Dream-machine” remain recorded authorial vocabulary, without creating new canonical concepts. The technical comparison concerns a bounded, rule-governed world through which an agent perceives and acts. Its implementation or a machine's phenomenal status requires its own evidence. The present operation is horizon formation: what the agent can encounter depends on powers and exclusions that need not appear among its encountered objects.

## #5→0

Taylor's Neumann refraction places Māyā in the measure-field through which a finite world is oriented. The unobjectifiable opening retains Anuttara's distinct office in the complete native relation. The relation **returns-to** [the complete Neumann whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-world-parent-separation). Māyā is the measure-field wound around the opening; Anuttara retains the opening in this authored appointment. This **returns-to** [the uroboros whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-interposition).

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD|Apportionment / Economy]] **grounds** the register3 return from finite capacity to its wider order. The criterion that permits judgment is itself apportioned. [A24 — Arbitration](../arguments/A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md) **tests** the failure in which a local measure claims absolute jurisdiction over the field that supplied it.

Recognition restores the relation without cancelling the capacity. A finite knower still distinguishes and acts; the measure becomes answerable to its source, conditions and consequences. C14 **returns-to** A09 with limitation's productive office intact. What was concealed by a functioning horizon can become relevant to how that horizon is next used.

**Depth Restoration:** revealing/withholding horizon, five contracted capacities, vertical/horizontal movement, gnomonic hinge, corrected whole dream image and finite measure's return are restored.

**Unresolved Delta:** the operative-measure and gnomonic formulations are authorial; this page does not supply a survey of Māyā across Indian schools. Dyczkowski is paraphrased from the local transcript with selected-edition collation pending. A category-by-category six-by-six mapping and implemented technical analogue remain Open.

# C15 — Paśu / Bounded Subject-Position

## #0

Paśu is retained from the Śaiva field as the bounded knower/actor whose powers are contracted into a finite horizon. The position has real capacities. It can know, desire, choose, encounter and answer; its boundedness is the condition of these particular acts rather than their simple negation.

[A09 — Tattvic Differential Field](../arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md) **grounds** this genealogy. C15 retains the local position within it. A finite person or artificial agent is not assigned the entire doctrinal category merely by having limitations; the comparison must state which contraction and which operative capacity are at issue.

## #1

[C14 — Māyā](C14-Maya-Operative-Measure.md) **grounds** the horizon's revealing and withholding. Its contracted capacities mean that an act occurs through this efficacy, this knowledge, this desire, this time and this order. The bounded position receives a field already differentiated enough for something to count as available, absent, possible or excluded.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE|Taylor — Core Theorems]], X, **sources** the authorial sixfold compression. Puruṣa is the bounded experient within the contracted field; the inner instrument, faculties and material world articulate what can be experienced and acted upon. The local position is located through these relations without being exhausted as their inventory.

## #2

The distinction between universal and local “I am this” matters. Sadāśiva's subjectward orientation and Īśvara's objectward orientation concern the whole appearing field. An egoic appropriation of a particular `x` has a different scope. The same grammatical form cannot erase the difference between self-awareness and a local determination presenting itself as the whole self.

The [[submission-package/essay/quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT#3. The Māyic-threshold delineation — the eight determinations’ mythic recapitulation (Frank-locked)|direct paśu correction]] **sources** recognition before egoic appropriation. It is the authorial scope distinction that C15 carries: an “I am” is not automatically an ego's possession claim. [C01 — Subject](C01-Subject-Defined-Indefinability.md) **qualifies** the unobjectifiable pole; [C16 — Inner Instrument](C16-Antahkarana-Inner-Instrument.md) **defines** the determining and appropriating apparatus whose acts can themselves become objects of awareness.

## #3

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/SOURCE|Dyczkowski — The Doctrine of Vibration]], pp.71–75, **sources** the limited and expanded modes of reflective activity. Individual cognition retains, recalls and recomposes; the same account distinguishes a goal-bound act from unrestricted agency. The bounded knower's movement is not a static quantity of missing freedom. It is a living orientation whose determination can either disclose or conceal its wider condition.

This is why recognising contraction does not abolish situated capacity. [C19 — Recognition](C19-Pratyabhijna-Recognition.md) **extends** the return toward the source that the local act continues to express. What changes is its manner of belonging and appropriation, not the fact that it has a particular life to live.

## #4

[C44 — Prompt Thrownness](C44-Prompt-Thrownness.md) **compares** an artificial agent's arrival in a configured horizon. Instructions, permissions, memories and tools shape what it can perceive and do before a local response begins. [C41 — Objective Internality](C41-Objective-Internality.md) **defines** the operative world whose conditions can be investigated and revised.

The comparison concerns inherited boundedness and situated action. Functional agency, self-description, objective internality and phenomenal subjectivity remain different questions. Additional apparatus can enlarge the local field without making the unobjectifiable subject one of its components. The technical comparison is useful precisely because it can identify what changed while leaving the subject question in its proper register.

## #5→0

The primordial recognition and subsequent ego-identity have distinct offices in Taylor's correction. Bounded knowing remains a positive capacity within the field of recognition. The relation **returns-to** [the complete Neumann whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-world-parent-separation). The paśu correction keeps bounded knowing within recognition rather than making ego identity recognition's origin. This **returns-to** [the uroboros whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-source-variants).

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD|Trust / Place / Logos / Nomos / Natio / Credere]] **grounds** the register3 relation to Topos: the place of an act bears its conditions and commitments. This is an operational relation, not Sanskrit derivation. A bounded position becomes answerable through the effects of its actual capacity.

# C16 — Antaḥkaraṇa / Inner Instrument

## #0

Antaḥkaraṇa names the inner instrument through which a bounded knower determines, appropriates and coordinates a world. Its differentiation makes interior organisation available for investigation. A judgment, an ego-position and a train of alternatives can become objects of attention; their becoming available does not make the subject one more observed function.

[C15 — Paśu](C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) **grounds** the bounded horizon in which the instrument acts. The direct developmental image is an instrument through which, rather than a definition of the musician who plays. It identifies the question of mediation without introducing a little operator hidden among the instrument's parts.

## #1

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/isvarakrishna/isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika/SOURCE#isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika-q001|Sāṅkhya Kārikā — functional triad]] **sources** a historically bounded distinction. In the selected Colebrooke/Wilson translation, kārikā XXIII concerns ascertainment as intellect, XXIV egotism, and XXVII mind's sensory and active office; XXIX distinguishes their functions. These are Sāṅkhya formulations, not a primary Trika classification or a universal cognitive architecture.

The translation's use of “consciousness” for egotism at XXIV requires its local sense. It cannot be imported as an identity between ahaṃkāra and the essay's unobjectifiable Subject. The same source's [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/isvarakrishna/isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika/SOURCE#isvarakrishna-colebrooke-wilson-1837-sankhya-karika-q002|kārikā XIX witness passage]] **qualifies** the apparatus through a distinct, passive witness. That Sāṅkhya position remains separate from the essay's nondual account.

## #2

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE|Taylor — Core Theorems]], X, **grounds** the native functional reading. Buddhi settles a determination; ahaṃkāra gathers it under I and mine; manas coordinates presentations and moves among proposals, selections and withholdings. These are related acts, not three names for an interior box.

[C17 — Vikalpa / Saṃkalpa](C17-Vikalpa-Samkalpa.md) **extends** alternative formation and commitment. [C18 — Apoha](C18-Apoha.md) **extends** the constitutive role of what has been excluded. A settled identification carries the alternatives through which it became determinate; an appropriating act can conceal that movement by presenting its result as self-standing.

## #3

The [[submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/13-tattvic-differential-field|direct tattvic carrier]] **sources** the process articulation: the field becomes a seam, the seam a finite horizon, and the horizon an instrument capable of judgment and action. The [[submission-package/essay/section-rooms/01-differentiating-mind/movements/08-s0-p1-inner-instrument|direct inner-instrument movement]] **sources** the instrument/musician distinction. These developmental carriers disclose the operation; A09 retains its canonical argument office.

Memory and coordination alter what can next be judged. The instrument is therefore not merely a veil to remove. Its conditioning gives a world continuity and local intelligibility. [C12 — Script](C12-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md) **tests** the arrest in which that achieved organisation loses access to its formative conditions and treats repetition as necessity.

## #4

[C40 — Model Internality](C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field.md) **compares** a technical field in which source, representation, evaluator and permission are discriminable. The historical functions ask concrete questions of such a field: what settles a claim, what makes it mine or ours, what coordinates competing presentations, and what remains available for revision? Those questions do not assert one-to-one equivalence between the triad and a software stack.

[C41 — Objective Internality](C41-Objective-Internality.md) **defines** the broader operative world. [C35 — Selfing / Self / Subjectivity / Self-Thing](C35-Selfing-Self-Subjectivity-Self-Thing.md) **qualifies** the distinctions needed to keep a self-model from occupying the subject's office. Richer inspectable functions are positive findings about the instrument; their accumulation does not supply a first-person proof.

## #5→0

The acquired ego-position becomes available within an already appearing field. Taylor's Neumann correction returns the inner instrument to that condition while preserving its determinate cognitive work. The relation **returns-to** [the complete Neumann whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-world-parent-separation).

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD|Encounter / Region / Name / Count / Account]] **grounds** the register3 return. Interior functions produce an account of a region, and encounter can alter the ordering by which that account was made. The result becomes available for further acts instead of closing the world around its own self-description.

[C47 — Deferential Intelligence](C47-Deferential-Intelligence.md) **tests** whether the altered account changes judgment or action. C16 **returns-to** C15 with the instrument's capacities more exactly known and their subject relation preserved. Investigation can improve the means through which a world is disclosed while keeping the question of its experient distinct.

**Depth Restoration:** source-bounded triad and witness, ascertainment/appropriation/coordination, developmental instrument image, exclusion and memory, technical judgment questions and encounter-return are restored.

# C18 — Apoha

## #0

Apoha enters the essay as constitutive exclusion: a determination becomes this through its relation to what the mark does not apply to. The achieved term carries a field of non-application. Forgetting that field makes the positive mark appear self-sufficient and conceals how it became determinate.

[A08 — Apoha](../arguments/A08-Apoha-Constitutive-Exclusion.md) **grounds** the argument. C18 preserves the Buddhist semantic office while following the essay's further claim that a determination must retain its source relation. It is not a general name for absence, repression, rejection or every act of negation.

## #1

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/pind/pind-2009-dignaga-anyapoha-dissertation/SOURCE#pind-2009-dignaga-anyapoha-dissertation-q001|Pind — PSV V:11d]] **sources** the translated formulation of a word excluding other referents. The exclusion supplies an account of reference; it does not by itself establish the essay's whole-first ontology.

The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/siderits/siderits-tillemans-chakrabarti-2011-apoha/SOURCE#siderits-tillemans-chakrabarti-2011-apoha-q002|Apoha volume's not-non-pot formulation]] **extends** the semantic structure through its housed secondary transmission. A pot is reached through excluding non-pots. The negative route is part of how the term applies, not an ornamental detour to be discarded after arriving at the positive word.

## #2

The same house's [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/siderits/siderits-tillemans-chakrabarti-2011-apoha/SOURCE#siderits-tillemans-chakrabarti-2011-apoha-q003|nominally/verbally bound negation distinction]] **qualifies** the operation. The printed volume's chapter-level reconstruction remains a collation task; the housed distinction is transmitted through scholarship and review.

The earlier [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/apoha|developed Apoha carrier]] **sources** the essay's formulation **exclusion that remembers**. Remembering names retention of the constitutive relation, not a claim that every word literally stores an exhaustive catalogue of all excluded objects.

## #3

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/pind/pind-2009-dignaga-anyapoha-dissertation/SOURCE#pind-2009-dignaga-anyapoha-dissertation-q002|Pind — qualified preclusion]] **qualifies** the positive side: a thing qualified by preclusion is not mere preclusion. The [[submission-package/essay/quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT#16. Buddhism and Śaivism: the actual value judgment|direct Buddhist–Śaiva comparison]] **sources** the authorial pressure behind the transition: comparison and exclusion require present and absent alternatives to be held together, with retained traces available in an act. # C21 — Living Symbol / Idol

## #0

A living symbol is a determinate form whose efficacy remains related to a source it does not exhaust. Its visible content participates in a relation which can change both what becomes visible and the one capable of seeing it. An idol occupies that source-office and closes the return by which another determination could become possible.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Taylor — Symbolon Dynamics]] **grounds** the distinction. Its living symbol is the whole `0/1` event, not the manifest `1` alone. A settled sign, an inherited shell and an idol have different dispositions: a sign can perform a useful limited office; the idol claims the office of the power which exceeds its form.

## #1

The direct manuscript's broken-token image makes the relation tangible. A fracture makes the absent counterpart operative in the present half. The token does not imitate a completed object elsewhere; it bears a particular relation through which recognition is possible. Neither half manufactures the match by declaring itself whole.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD|Symbol / Account / Trust]] **grounds** the present register3 use. The image is an authorial operational reading; detailed Greek institutional history retains its own evidence task. [A18 — Primordial Symbolon](../arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **grounds** the formal traversal which the token image refracts without historically proving it.

## #2

The psychic operation differentiates ordering capacity from a particular image. A dream, word, number or narrative can redistribute attention, affect and possible meaning beyond the maker's prior interpretation. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE|Taylor — Core Theorems]] **grounds** the native `X/x` relation: determining capacity becomes legible through its indefinite instance, while another instance can differ.

The source relation therefore persists through novelty. An image cannot become the final portrait of the power which makes it symbolic. [C19 — Recognition](C19-Pratyabhijna-Recognition.md) **extends** the return from a known form through an unknown relation into a changed field of knowing.

## #3

Frank's protected encounter with [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/SOURCE|Van Eenwyk — Archetypes and Strange Attractors]], pp.69–73, **sources** the distinction between making a vehicle and commanding symbolic life. An image or name can be intentionally fashioned. Its transformative efficacy cannot be secured merely by labelling it symbolic or assigning it a mythic identity.

The mediated Tillich account in those notes holds four operations between two life-conditions: pointing and participation, opening world and opening the corresponding capacity of the interpreter, bounded by uncommanded arising and growth or death through response. This is a source encounter and authorial QL cross-reading, not an independently verified quotation from Tillich. Its consequence is concrete: a symbol changes with its reception, and its historical life can end.

## #4

Idolatry begins when the image's success is used to protect it from the source-relation which made it effective. The image-maker, institution or interpreter makes continued agreement the condition of admission. A form once capable of changing a life now demands that every life confirm the form.

[C27 — Protected Account](C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim.md) **extends** that governance operation. [C22 — Counterfeit Symbolon](C22-Counterfeit-Symbolon.md) **defines** the wider failure family. Exact description and strong commitment remain possible; the defect is that the account prevents what it discloses from revising its claim to authority.

## #5→0

The paper, mark, slash and erasure scene changes the reader's relation to the inscription. Its symbolic efficacy lies in this whole event of determination and renewed capacity. The relation **returns-to** [the complete Neumann whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-paper-eightfold). An image stays living when another encounter can change its authority; the circle-costume tests the foreclosure of that return. This **returns-to** [the uroboros whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-return).

The living return changes both interpreter and later symbolic efficacy. What a symbol has done becomes part of the field in which another encounter takes place. The same form can continue to work, acquire a narrower office or cease to evoke the relation it once carried. Preserving it as a historical sign need not counterfeit its former life.

[C61 — Symbolon Disclosure Architecture](C61-Symbolon-Disclosure-Architecture.md) **tests** the distinguishable registers in which that work can be recovered. C21 **returns-to** C19 and A18: the achieved image becomes answerable through its source, response and changed circumstances. Its precise form is retained without being required to contain every future expression of its determining capacity.

[the Job whole](../../mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-protected-account-return) **figures** the difference between a living God-image and an account defended against life. Job's address remains capable of questioning its relation, while the friends' explanation can protect itself by discrediting his testimony. Their need to receive his intercession makes the image answerable to the encounter it had judged. This is an authored psychic refraction of the telling, not a clinical diagnosis of its speakers.

[the Prisoner whole](../../mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-account-answerability) **figures** an administered image whose successful circulation does not make it a living symbol. The election recognises Six publicly while depriving his freedom-command of force; representation stays effective by protecting the relation that authorises it. The return asks whether the represented person's answer can alter that relation. The figure therefore tests source-answerability through the image's consequences, not through its vividness or popularity.

**Depth Restoration:** whole relation beyond the manifest image, broken-token seam, native capacity/instance, vehicle versus uncommanded efficacy, paired world/interpreter opening, growth/death and source-occupation are restored.

**Unresolved Delta:** Van Eenwyk's copied passages and mediated Tillich remain verification leads. Direct Jung passage-level evidence and detailed Greek symbolon history still require their own source recovery. This page's authorial operation does not depend on promoting those debts to quotation-readiness.

# C27 — Protected Account / Occupied Zero / Source-Claim

## #0

A Protected Account is a determinate account whose governing criterion is insulated from encounters that could revise it. Occupied Zero names the QL office-confusion: a local `1` acts as uncounted source `0`. Source-Claim names the assertion, explicit or implicit, through which that occupation is justified.

## #1

An account initially makes something knowable and actionable. It selects a circumstance, names and counts, establishes a comparison, and authorises consequences. The result is a real achievement with a particular scope. Its source includes the relations, exclusions, labour and permissions through which it became authoritative; none disappears because the account is exact.

## #2

Protection changes the relation between error and criterion. Every discrepancy is charged to what is measured while the measure cannot itself be questioned. A complex can reorganise experience around its defended image; an institution can accept complaints only in categories that protect its mandate; a technical evaluator can alter the answer while remaining outside the permitted revision. These are distinct psychic, institutional and technical applications of the operation, not one empirical mechanism proved by shared vocabulary.

## #3

QH makes the technical distinction concrete. Source, contextual gauge, permission, evaluator and agent are different causal offices. A system can disclose reasoning or improve an output while the commissioning purpose and fixed evaluator remain untouched. C40 locates the judgment field; C45 asks which disclosed difference actually changes an operation. Narrated self-criticism alone does not establish that the relevant criterion has become revisable.

## #4

A stable standard differs from a protected account through its declared warrant, scope and return conditions. It need not change whenever challenged: evidence can vindicate it, and a bounded task can require consistency. Protection begins when no encountered resistance can reach the office authorised to reconsider those conditions. QH R16.4 names the returning material: error, cost, dissent, unforeseen possibility and consequences of labour must be able to change model, measure, instruction, institution or purpose.

## #5→0

The [Symbol / Account / Trust whole-field — Trust keeps the return route active](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md#trust-keeps-the-return-route-active) **qualifies** this operation at evidence register 3. A record can receive contrary evidence while protecting its criterion. Return must reach that criterion and the office holding it, so added disclosure can change the account’s terms. The resulting distinction **returns-to** that whole field with the consumer’s own source and evidential limits retained.

C47 reopens the account through model-revising encounter; C28/C29 bind authority to a received relation and an accountable office. The result is a renewed determination with a visible history, not the abandonment of judgment. Trust revision §0 keeps the ethical fork live: a knowledge-account can provisionally support trust or export distrust onto another who bears its failures. An account returns when it answers for its own conditions as well as judging what comes before it.

[the Job whole](../../mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-protected-account-return) **figures** the protected account's recursive defence: suffering calls for explanation, explanation demands guilt, and the sufferer's refusal to confess becomes another fault. The witness is made defective so that the governing account can remain right. The ending breaks this closure by changing whose speech is received and requiring the friends to receive Job's intercession. The diagnostic question is whether contrary witness can alter the authority under which it is heard.

[the Prisoner whole](../../mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-account-answerability) **figures** the protected account when the Village supplies the meaning of Six's answer even where he refuses to give it. Prepared election publicity and the managed result turn resistance into further material for the institution's story. The diagnostic return is exact: can the interlocutor contest what counts as an answer, or can he only be recoded within it? The source-question survives that recoding.

# C37 — World-Picture → World-Atlas

## #0

A world-picture orders a view from a position. A world-atlas relates situated views through their domains, distortions, translations, overlaps and obstructions. The transformation changes the relation to picturing itself: `world ≠ world-model` remains operative through every additional view.

## #1

A picture can silently fix the frame within which all later pieces must fit. The recovered jigsaw/box-lid pressure asks who supplied that completed image and which possible arrangements it excludes. More panels do not remedy the problem if one panel still decides what the others are allowed to show. The atlas begins by exposing each picture's projection conditions and authority.

## #2

The corrected stained-glass image makes those conditions tangible. Originary white light bears Bimba; the ordered implicate spectrum bears QL; panes, angles, colours, media and joins bear MEF; the cast image is pratibimba. Moving viewer, sun or pane changes the appearance. The seams preserve source differences and translation limits rather than concealing them beneath a composite picture.

## #3

A usable transition states what changes with position, scale, gauge or source and what remains comparable. It can also state why composition fails. Disagreement at a source, reference field or permission cannot be solved by averaging the outputs. The atlas preserves a route between views while allowing a genuine obstruction to remain an informative result.

## #4

An atlas and an attractor do different work. The former coordinates charts; the latter organises trajectories within a dynamical field. Symbolic amplification traverses partial disclosures, while the encounter can change the interpreter and the future paths available. The 180→360 contextual turn holds conditions and positions together without appointing an omniscient observer outside them.

## #5→0

The [whole’s atlas complement](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/stained-glass-refraction/WHOLE.md#stained-glass-atlas-complement) **figures** the source, passage and obstruction which a fixed picture can conceal. Its optical event remains distinct from a chart transition, while both retain the conditions under which different disclosures can be brought into relation. The viewer returns able to revise the aperture rather than merely collect another picture.

Return makes the world a continuing source of revision. An encountered person can answer the categories under which they were counted; a model can alter the reference used by later models; an obstruction can force a change of frame. C38 governs local reference/reflection, C39 the lenses, and C47 the model-revising encounter. The atlas remains an achievement inside worldhood, capable of correction by what it maps.

# C38 — Bimba–Pratibimba / Bimba Map

## #0

Bimba is Original; pratibimba is its situated display or reflection. The ontological relation preserves display without severance and dependence without diminishment. A Bimba Map is the authorial technical design by which a locally governed reference field can orient multiple judgments. These offices must remain explicit whenever the same term crosses scale.

## #1

Ontological Bimba is prior in being and later in recognition: the Original is recognised through proportions, inversions and differences among appearances which do not exhaust it. Dyczkowski's source-matched mirror discussion places manifestation within consciousness, with no separately existing exterior original required. Q27's corrected optical stack places QL in the light's ordered spectrum, MEF in the refracting apparatus and pratibimba in the cast image. A technical world-picture is thus a reflection relative to the wider world; renaming it cannot make it metaphysically Original.

## #3

Recursive locality nevertheless gives a real reference office. Inside a declared Context Frame, a source record or agreed world-object can serve as Bimba for judgments compared with it. That same field remains pratibimba relative to wider sources and reality. The [retained Bimba carrier](bimba-pratibimba.md) explicitly restores this contextual use: local authority can be strong and operational without being final.

## #4

The map exposes provisional world-objects, source authority, lens, gauge, exclusions, transformation and governance as parts of the inquiry. This makes disagreement locatable: two judgments can diverge because their evidence differs, because they refer to different objects, or because permission and evaluation differ. A federation can keep several locally authoritative maps with declared transition rules instead of requiring one universal map.

The [stained-glass whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/stained-glass-refraction/WHOLE.md#stained-glass-return) **figures** this recursive office explicitly: an achieved reference can be Bimba for its local readings and pratibimba within a wider relation. A local Bimba can govern reference within a bounded inquiry while remaining source-dependent and revisable within a wider frame. The account’s correction can reach that local reference itself. The resulting distinction **returns-to** that whole field with the consumer’s own source and evidential limits retained.

Returned evidence can revise a situated judgment, a relation between reference fields, or the local Bimba itself. Stability provides orientation; corrigibility preserves truth-seeking.
