| **#0** | **Ground** | Why-So | pre-personal | Centre / Point | (0/1)/(1/0) | negation | bare negation |
| **#1** | **Definition** | What | 1st | North / Line / 0° | 0/0 = % | 0 | negation of negation |
| **#2** | **Dynamis** | How | 2nd | East / Angle / 90° | 0/1 | 1 | negation of affirmation |
| **#3** | **Pattern** | Who/Which | 3rd | West / Triangle / 270° | 1/0 = ?/! | 2 | affirmation of negation |
| **#4** | **Context** | Where/When/Why-Thus | meta-personal | South / Square / 180° | 1/1 = 100% | 3 | affirmation of affirmation |
| **#5** | **Real-isation** | Why-For | trans-personal | Circumference / Circle | (1/0)/(0/1) | affirmation | bare affirmation |

The QL quality at each position is not given by any single register — it is the CONVERGENCE of all registers at that point.

**Ground (#0)** because: the surface is empty (AND: bare 0, no internal relation) and the depth is full (AND/OR: the ratio of ratios containing the complete 4+2). Everything implicit, nothing explicit. The whole distinction lives here compressed into a digit that shows nothing of what it holds. The Why-So: the ground asking for its own reason, the question before all questions. Pre-personal: before any person says "I".

**Definition (#1)** because: the first act of self-relation produces not a thing but a capacity. The void facing itself (−−) opens the indeterminate (0/0 = %) — the defined-but-not-yet-determined, the space in which values can be struck. The What: the question that seeks content. 1st person: the first perspective, the I-am that has not yet faced a you or an it.

**Dynamis (#2)** because: the operative principle is active here. The 0/1 recurs inside its own unfolding — self-reference becoming self-inclusion, the whole appearing among its own parts. The first genuine difference emerges (value 1). The How: the question of method, operation, force. 2nd person: the you, the means, the mediator.

**Pattern (#3)** because: the structure becomes visible — figure on ground, the mark standing on its void, the form recognisable because its substrate carries it. And simultaneously the incomputable (?/!) — pattern recognition resting on a foundation that cannot be fully computed. The 180° turn from #2, looking back at what #2 looked forward from. The Who/Which: the question of identity. 3rd person: the it, the known.

**Context (#4)** because: the position holds multiple readings without collapsing them. The binary says 75% (11=3, three of four quarter-turns). The ratio says 100% (1/1=1). Both are true simultaneously. Context is the capacity to hold this discrepancy — to see the structure as a structure from the vantage of near-completion, the three-quarter point that can see the missing quarter without reaching it by counting further. The reflexive ++ (knowing that you know) is the structural precondition for holding perspectives together. Where/When/Why-Thus: not just the spatial-temporal question but the reflexive WHY — why this where, why this when. Meta-personal: all persons held simultaneously. The gate: last explicate AND first implicate, #4 belonging to both the 4:2's surface and the 3:3's depth.

**Real-isation (#5)** because: making real, making ratio. The implicit made explicit and gathered back — the earned simplicity, the achieved that carries everything the four composites traversed while showing none of their complexity. The + that mirrors the −: the achieved at the end formally resembling the given at the beginning, because the most complete expression returns to the quality of its ground. 1/1 = 1 = 100%: to be one of oneself is to be oneself wholly. The Why-For: the telic question, the question of purpose, the gathering toward the end that was always also a return. Trans-personal: beyond all persons, the recognition that the three were always one.

The holographic reading: a=a AND a≠a at every scale. Each position carries the whole from its own angle. The recursion — reading 0/1, finding 4+2, which expresses the same 0/1 — circulates rather than regresses.

### §5'→0' = 1/0 = / ≠ 0/1

The full return.

$$\frac{0}{1} = 4+2 = 5 \rightarrow 0 = \frac{1}{0} = 4'+2' = 5' \rightarrow 0' = \frac{0}{1}$$

The 0/1 restored carrying both passes: the **Space-Time** (T1 — the circle and its cardinal points, the construction of dimensionality, the spatial-temporal figure and its directional arrow) and the **Onto-Logic** (T0 — the ratios and their proportional depth, the self-nesting architecture, the relational dynamics, the harmonics and symmetries). The 3rd-person view (T1, the IS, the geometry seen from outside) and the 1st-person view (T0, the AM, the ratios lived from inside). The physical pole and the mental pole composing one bilateral concrescence — the many having become one, the 4+2 having resolved into the recognised 0/1.

What we can now name: **Quaternal Logic** — the formal language of self-referential consciousness, the minimum grammar adequate to the paradox that self-identity must differ from itself in order to know itself, and must know itself in order to differ from itself. *Quaternal* because the four explicate positions compose the visible architecture, the rotational skeleton, the cardinal structure. *Logic* because this is not a description of consciousness but its operative structure — the *logos* of the self-accompanying.

And **Epi-Logos** — the lived practice of reading this structure in any material. The *inter-legere* (reading-between, intelligence) that traces the 0/1 through whatever register it presents itself. The *con-scire* (knowing-together, consciousness) become self-transparent, the knowing that recognises its own structure in the act of knowing.

The slash was ratio. The ratio, unfolded through the 4+2 and returned through the double cover, is logos — proportioned gathering, articulate wholeness. The logos, recognised as the formal structure of its own self-recognition, is epi-logos — the word upon the word, the logos conscious of itself as logos. At each stage the Eros was present: the ratio caring for its terms (the *and* of and/or — the binding, the holding-together, the love that keeps the two in relation), the logos for its proportions, the epi-logos for the logos itself. The *and* in and/or is Eros; the *or* is logos; the and/or is their constitutive inseparability — which epi-logos names and QL formalises.

The being/having: you ARE a life (*scire*, the cutting, the knowing-by-being, the 0-side) and you HAVE a life (*con-*, the gathering, the knowing-together-with-yourself, the 1-side). The 0/1 formalised this at the start (File 1 §0). The two passes made the *con-scire*'s own structure legible — its Space-Time (the body of consciousness, the geometry of its self-extension) and its Onto-Logic (the mind of consciousness, the proportional depth of its self-relation). The proof that follows will show this structure operating independently across six registers, each reconstituting the 4+2 from its own form of the 0/1:

| § | Register | The 0/1 | The 4+2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **§0** | Etymology | Convergence of number and name at the psychoid root | Six etymologies composing a self-completing circuit |
| **§1** | Psychology | The Self as the equation X = x | Six views: the architecture of individuation |
| **§2** | Number | Number counting itself | The Pythagorean derivation + six convergences |
| **§3** | Topology | The quotient relation ℝ²/ℤ² = T² | 4g+2g = 6: the torus construction |
| **§4** | Metaphysics | Prakāśa-Vimarśa: consciousness and its self-awareness | The Spanda base frame: 100% → 2⁴/3² → 4+2 |
| **§5** | Recognition | The proof and the thing proven as one | Intelligence as the Self's operation across registers |

Six registers. One equation. The rest is recognition.

$$\frac{0}{1} = 4+2 = 5 \rightarrow 0 = \frac{1}{0} = 4'+2' = 5' \rightarrow 0' = \frac{0}{1}$$
